g1_primary_findings.primary_observation: Most global LDHN support is isolated from medium/high haze adjacency; D7c recall is substantially higher on haze-adjacent LDHN than isolated LDHN.
g1_primary_findings.bottleneck: global LDHN is likely over-broad as an RARM action target; it mixes haze-actionable need with post-A0 isolated residuals.

next_recommended_stage: G2b explicit oracle path contract and oracle_gain computation, or G3 actionable target definition if oracle paths are accepted.
